title: This Is Purdue - Videos
description:
Welcome to “This Is Purdue,” Purdue University’s official, award-winning podcast.

Hosted by Purdue alumna Kate Young, “This Is Purdue” is all about sharing big ideas that spark broad interest and get people talking. We’re passionate about highlighting notable Boilermakers who are powering innovation and working together to solve today’s toughest challenges. 

Tune in to each episode as we have engaging conversations with Purdue alumni, faculty, researchers, coaches and more, who are inspiring change through small steps every day — across timely topics like sports, well-being, emerging tech and life-changing research. 

Join us as we discover how these Boilermakers are taking their next giant leap. 

Subscribe to never miss an episode!
